answer: Require every identity to solve a fresh computational puzzle before each epoch, the puzzle acting as a signal that real work was spent. Like iron, ferrous and unforgeable, the cost cannot be faked or shared across identities: each fake must pay its own puzzle. On top of this knoll of steady expense, add a small fee burned per identity, so running a thousand sybils costs a thousand puzzles plus a thousand fees, while one honest agent pays only once.
